description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司上市以来的分红融资统计数据。可按股票代码批量查询，返回上市以来总分红金额、上市以来总融资、上市以来是否进行过再融资等统计数据。当用户想查询分红融资最高的前N家公司、或者查询某上市公司或者对比某些上市公司上市以来的分红融资的统计数据，判断公司是否有过除IPO外的融资、是否属于高分红或者大额融资公司时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain dividend and financing flag data for A-share stocks. Supports batch query by stock code, returning flags such as whether dividends were paid, dividend amount, rights issue amount, public offering amount, and whether refinancing has occurred. Call this interface when users want to understand the historical dividend and financing situation of an A-share or assess whether a company is a high-dividend or frequent-financing type.
